podcast.body: In August 2001, this track by Italian music DJ Spiller made history by being the very first digital file uploaded onto a prototype Apple iPod and successfully played back. This event was a crucial milestone in the development and testing of the iPod, marking the beginning of portable digital music's widespread adoption. "It was by an Italian music DJ who went by the name Spiller, and the track is RoofJet... That has gone down in history as the first song ever to be uploaded on and played back from an iPod."

podcast.body: Released in 2000 by Cristiano Spiller and his friends, this single was named after a nightclub in Miami. According to those present on the Apple campus in Cupertino, California, this song was the very first to be transferred from CD to MP3 and then onto a prototype iPod. "According to those who were there on the Apple campus in Cupertino, California, this song was the first to be transferred from CD to MP3 to a prototype iPod."

podcast.body: The Italian producer Spiller's track "GrooveJet" was the very first song transferred to a prototype iPod in Cupertino in the year 2000. This occurred during the development phase of Apple's iconic portable music device. "The track is GrooveJet and it was the first song transferred to a prototype iPod in Cupertino that year."
